Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

Simplification of pension procedure submission of undertaking by along with pension papers-  
- (i) The required undertaking (i.e. for refunding any excess payment made by the pension disbursing Bank) may be obtained by the Head of Office from the retiring Government servant along with
- Form 6 and other documents.  
- (ii) The undertaking shall be forwarded to the pension disbursing bank with the PPO by the Accounts Officer I CPAO.
